name: Utö - Ålö Connector

description.short: A short, easy gravel-road connector between the Utö and Ålö SAT sections, controlled by firing-range stay-on-road rules rather than facilities.
description.long: The Utö - Ålö Connector follows a gravel road from Gula Villan on Utö to just south of Ålö Bridge, passing through an active military firing range. It is intentionally unmarked because hikers must stay on the road at all times. Use it as a practical link between sections; services are reached by continuing north toward Gruvbryggan or south toward Ålö brygga/Båtshaket, not on the connector itself.
doNotOverstate: Do not present the connector as a normal facility-rich hiking section.
Do not encourage side trips off the gravel road through the military firing range.
Do not import Ålö ferry-quay, Båtshaket or Ålö Storsand services as on-connector facilities.
Do not import the private/uncertain pump near Ålö Bridge as public drinking water.

notes: Route shape: linear gravel-road connector between the Utö and Ålö SAT sections, from Gula Villan on Utö to just south of Ålö Bridge.
Iteration 1 found the connector should be treated as a no-service continuity/safety section, not a facility-rich trail section.
The English official URL is /section/uto-alo-connector-2/; the non-2 URL currently resolves to Swedish/localized content.
Facilities at Ålö brygga, Båtshaket and Ålö Storsand are useful future Ålö-section context but should not be normal connector imports.
Försvarsmakten weekly/current notices can rotate. Store stable parent pages and require current on-site/live checks for restrictions.
Outdooractive, SAT GPX, Google My Maps and the SAT print PDF appear to share route provenance, so they corroborate geometry but are not fully independent.
Iteration 2 confirmed Gula Villan may remain connector start context, but Gruvbryggan/Spränga are Utö-owned access/services and Ålö brygga/Båtshaket/Storsand are Ålö-owned records.
Iteration 2 confirmed the Ålö Bridge pump is a real near-corridor feature but private/uncertain; keep it pending/suppressed and out of normal water import.
Iteration 2 confirmed the connector road should not be described as always passable during firing-range activity; barriers, current notices and on-site information override cached route data.
Iteration 3 found no official/local confirmation that the Ålö Bridge pump is public or potable; it was moved from pending water to explicit suppression.
Iteration 3 moved the Ålö Bridge board from secondary POI candidate to future wayfinding/orientation metadata only.
Iteration 3 confirmed the connector copy should stay functional and caution-forward: a practical road link, not a scenic or facility-rich section.
Iteration 4 confirmed official SAT pages, PDF, GPX and KML remain live and match the stored connector facts.
Iteration 4 reinforced the current-notice pattern for Utö skjutfält: stable parent pages plus dated weekly PDFs, with local barriers and boards overriding cached trail data.
Iteration 4 found HiiKER and Komoot too weak or derivative for connector facility claims; they remain source-caveat context only.
